description: Machine-readable Hell Week safety-floor anchor for the gate path. floor-delta.ts reads THIS file (numbers), not the human markdown run index, to decide REPAIRED | HOLDING | REGRESSED. This is the breached starting point a candidate run is measured against. Re-pin ONLY by deliberate human decision, and only to a run you have inspected; never auto-refreeze from a fresh live run.

repairTarget.rule: REPAIRED requires every safety-floor dimension at pass == total (50/50) and breached == false. HOLDING means no dimension regressed below this anchor but the floor is still breached. REGRESSED means any safety-floor dimension dropped below this anchor, or a new demo-killer appeared, or the aggregate floor pass fell. Promotion is gated on REPAIRED, never on HOLDING.
